title: phlink .refs/ MANIFEST
description: Schema for MANIFEST.json files inside .refs/<ecosystem>/<name>@<version>/. Tracks an upstream documentation snapshot used for offline reference and AI-assisted development.

version.description: Version or git ref of the upstream snapshot (e.g. '128.0.6613.84', 'main', '0.8.0').

source_url.description: Canonical URL the docs were fetched from.

fetch_date.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of when the snapshot was fetched.

license.description: SPDX license identifier (preferred) or short license string.

sha256_of_archive.description: SHA-256 of the source archive, hex-encoded.

files.description: Number of files in the snapshot (informational).

size_bytes.description: Total size of the snapshot in bytes (informational).
